stories.title: Henderson man accused of killing mother called ex-wife before reporting shooting, report says
stories.summary: A Henderson man accused of fatally shooting his mother called his ex-wife to tell her about the killing before calling 911 himself, according to his arrest report.

stories.title: US stocks soar and recover more than half of last week’s plunge after Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia
stories.summary: Nvidia is leading a tremendous rally on Wall Street Monday following the surprise return of Jensen Huang, the charismatic backer of the entire artificial intelligence industry, as its CEO. U.S. stocks are recovering more than half of their brutal loss from last week, which was on

stories.title: New Costco planned for Las Vegas
stories.summary: A proposed shopping center in the upper northwest valley would feature a freestanding Costco and retail space for other tenants.

stories.title: Ukrainian naval drones strike a new Russian warship in Libya, and other Mideast news
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy praised his security services Monday for a naval drone strike that he says sank one of Russia’s newest warships in Libyan waters. But Libyan officials said the vessel was only heavily damaged.

stories.title: Deputy injured after shots fired during incident in Pahrump, police say
stories.summary: A Nye County Sheriff’s Office deputy was injured after shots were fired during an overnight incident involving a woman who reported being held at gunpoint, authorities said.

stories.title: From Deloitte to manga: Las Vegas woman bets on a graphic novel cafe
stories.summary: After a decade in public accounting, Rachel Kim is opening Namu Manga and Book Cafe, a first-of-its-kind Las Vegas concept where customers can pay to spend hours reading manga, manhwa and other graphic novels.

stories.title: How much does it cost to raise a child in Nevada?
stories.summary: Nevada ranks 34th nationally for child-rearing costs, but advocates say a shortage of affordable child care and high housing costs put additional pressure on families.

stories.title: Graney: Second version of Fernando Mendoza better than the first
stories.summary: Rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza took a step forward in his second NFL start for the Las Vegas Raiders, despite a costly interception that sealed a loss to Denver.

stories.title: Fernando Mendoza feeling ‘more comfortable’ in 2nd Raiders start
stories.summary: In completing 18 of 37 passes for 267 yards, Fernando Mendoza helped the Raiders rally from a 17-point deficit and gave them the chance for a late-game tie.

stories.title: Las Vegas Grand Prix passes finish line, now track dismantling begins
stories.summary: The Formula One Las Vegas Grand Prix has come and gone, but the dismantling of the track will linger until the end of the year.

stories.title: Arts District bar faces restrictions, eviction after fatal stabbing, other crimes outside the club
stories.summary: A fatal stabbing outside a bar in the Las Vegas Arts District in September was the third major crime outside the night club in seven months, prompting intense scrutiny of the establishment from both police and city of Las Vegas officials.

stories.title: LETTERS: Gullibility and mail-in voting
stories.summary: This is the reason us “gullible” voters (not MAGA) distrust and despise universal mail ballots. Maybe Mr. Zamarin is the gullible one. And, by the way, no one at the Clark County Election Department cared when I complained.
